name: Design token build
description: Optional cross-platform design-token compilation; prefer zero-dependency static tokens until a measured need justifies a toolchain.
approval_rule: Owner approval required before adding a new package-manager/toolchain dependency to production LucyOS.
rollback: Disable the feature flag, remove generated integration wiring, and retain canonical token source as plain repository data.
implementation_notes: Candidate only. Style Dictionary is the researched primary; no dependency is installed by catalog sync.
cost_notes: Open-source candidate; dependency/toolchain maintenance cost must be benchmarked against the current zero-dependency workflow.
